reading_cite.note: The National Diet Library records the title reading as マコト センパイ, so 真 is マコト. The store had assembled マ from the character alone and this entry had rendered it Shin, which are three answers to one question and at most one of them could be right. 真 as a given name is ordinarily マコト; マ and シン are readings the character takes in compounds, and neither is how a person is addressed.
Guess confirmed, and NDL supplies the boundary. KADOKAWA, 真先輩の前ではかっこつけられない!, the example work.
